dct_description_sm: Azerbaijan administrative level 0-1 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 1 level: - Admin 1: 74 Dates associated with this dataset: - 31 January 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 17 October 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 24 November 2020: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 24 November 2020: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
